title: Admin Swords
description: Wield incredibly OP admin & god-tier swords with reality-bending abilities! Supports Fabric, Forge, & NeoForge. Fully compatible with Better Combat, JEI and Jade (further development in progress).
body:
# Admin Swords

Admin Swords adds a collection of highly overpowered, custom weapons to the game. It is built entirely for players and server admins who want to bypass standard game limits and abuse broken mechanics.

The Neoforge files have yet to be updated and misses some crucial features and the sword overhaul. Will fix soon.

### Key Features

*   **The Half-Dead Curse:** Hitting a target traps them in a half-dead state. The entity becomes completely immobilized, unable to act, and extremely difficult to kill. 
*   **Overpowered Stats:** The arsenal features weapons that ignore standard vanilla damage caps and limitations.
*   **Passive Core Abilities:** Instead of forcing you to use active hotkeys to trigger powers, the swords use passive upgrades to provide permanent buffs while equipped.

### Modpack Support

You are fully allowed to include Admin Swords in any Modrinth or CurseForge modpack.
